name: LOCTITE® 222™ Threadlocker
compatible_materials: All metals including passive substrates (e.g. aluminum, brass, stainless steel)
limitations: Low strength, easily disassembled with hand tools
usage_instructions: Clean with SF 7070/7063. Apply several drops to engagement area. Assemble and tighten.

name: LOCTITE® 243™ Threadlocker
compatible_materials: All metals (active and passive like stainless steel, aluminum, plated surfaces)
limitations: Disassembly requires standard hand tools
usage_instructions: Clean threads with LOCTITE SF 7070 or SF 7063. Apply drops to engagement area. Assemble and torque.

name: LOCTITE® 263™ Threadlocker
compatible_materials: Metals, heavy duty studs, bolts
limitations: Requires localized heating (232°C for 5 min) for disassembly while hot
usage_instructions: Squirt drops into female blind hole threads and onto bolt. Assemble and torque.

name: LOCTITE® 270™ Threadlocker
compatible_materials: All metals including passive substrates
applications: Permanent blocking of studs on motor blocks
limitations: High strength permanent locking; disassembly requires heating to 250°C
usage_instructions: Clean threads, apply drops to engagement area, assemble and tighten.

name: LOCTITE® 277™ Threadlocker
compatible_materials: Heavy metal fasteners, studs over 1 inch
limitations: Requires localized heat (232°C) for disassembly
usage_instructions: Apply to threads, assemble and torque.

name: LOCTITE® 290™ Threadlocker
compatible_materials: Metals, existing weld porosities, pre-assembled threaded fasteners
applications: Sealing weld porosities and casting micro-porosities
limitations: Requires heating for weld porosity sealing (80°C steel, 50°C aluminum/stainless)
usage_instructions: Apply drops to nut/bolt juncture of pre-assembled parts. Wicks into capillary gaps.

name: LOCTITE® 2400™ Health & Safety Threadlocker
compatible_materials: All metals
applications: Medium strength threadlocking with enhanced user health & safety profile (no hazard symbols)
limitations: Disassembly with hand tools
usage_instructions: Apply to cleaned threads, assemble and tighten.

name: LOCTITE® 2700™ Health & Safety Threadlocker
compatible_materials: All metals
applications: Permanent high strength threadlocking without hazard labels
limitations: Disassembly requires heating
usage_instructions: Apply to threads, assemble and tighten.

name: LOCTITE® 55™ Pipe Sealing Cord
chemistry: Multi-filament polyamide cord with inert coated paste
max_gap: Tapered and straight pipe threads up to 4 inches
compatible_materials: Metal and plastic threaded pipes/fittings
applications: Adjustable fittings (allows backing off up to 45°)
limitations: Do not use on pure oxygen systems without verification
usage_instructions: Wind onto male thread overlapping in cross direction. Assemble and tighten.

name: LOCTITE® 518™ Flange Sealant
compatible_materials: Rigid iron, steel, and aluminum flanges
limitations: Not for flexible sheet metal flanges
usage_instructions: Clean flanges with SF 7070. Spray SF 7649 Primer on one side if passive metal. Apply continuous bead, circling all bolt holes. Mate parts.

name: LOCTITE® 577™ Thread Sealant
max_gap: Coarse threads up to M80 / 3 inches
compatible_materials: All metals (steel, brass, aluminum, stainless steel)
limitations: Do not use on pure oxygen or strong oxidizers
usage_instructions: Clean parts with SF 7070. Apply continuous bead 360° around male threads starting 1-2 threads back. Tighten.

name: LOCTITE® 638™ Retaining Compound
compatible_materials: Cylindrical metal parts, shafts, bearings, gears, couplings
applications: Shaft mounted assemblies (slip fit & press fit)
limitations: High strength; disassembly may require heat (230°C)
usage_instructions: Clean parts. Apply to shaft engagement area or inside bore. Assemble with twisting motion.

name: LOCTITE® 648™ Retaining Compound
compatible_materials: All cylindrical metal assemblies
applications: Gears and sprockets on gearbox shafts
limitations: Tight clearance parts (<0.15 mm)
usage_instructions: Clean parts with SF 7063/7070. Apply to leading edge, press or slip assemble.

name: LOCTITE® 660™ Quick Metal Retaining Compound
compatible_materials: Worn metal shafts, keyways, housings, shims
applications: Restoring slip fit on worn parts
limitations: NOT recommended for radial/lateral gaps exceeding 0.020 inch (0.5 mm)
usage_instructions: Clean surface. Apply primer SF 7649 if gap > 0.005". Apply paste to keyway/shaft gap. Assemble.

name: LOCTITE® EA 3478™ Superior Metal
cure_time: Working time: 20 min; Machinable: 2 hrs; Full: 24 hrs
compatible_materials: Steel, cast iron, stainless steel, aluminum
limitations: Requires surface roughening/grit blasting (SA2.5) for maximum adhesion
usage_instructions: Mix Part A & B (4:1 by vol / 7.25:1 by weight). Apply firmly to grit-blasted clean surface. Allow cure then machine on lathe to original dimensions.

name: LOCTITE® PC 7117™ Chemical Resistant Coating
cure_time: Recoat window: tacky stage; Full cure: 24 hrs
compatible_materials: Cast iron, steel, pump volutes, impellers, tanks
applications: Protecting internal pump casings against sulfuric acid & harsh chemicals
limitations: Requires grit blasting to SA 2.5 profile prior to application
usage_instructions: Sandblast surface (SA 2.5). Apply SF 7515 rust inhibitor if needed. Mix and brush apply 2 coats (0.5 mm each).

name: LOCTITE® PC 7227™ Brushable Ceramic
strength: High Gloss Low Friction Wear Resistant
cure_time: Functional cure: 6 hrs; Full cure: 24 hrs
compatible_materials: Pump impellers, volutes, turbine blades, pipe elbows
applications: Restoring and coating pump impellers & turbine blades
limitations: Fine particle abrasion / cavitation protection
usage_instructions: Sandblast SA 2.5. Clean with SF 7063. Mix and brush apply onto prepared surface.

name: LOCTITE® EA E-20HP™ Structural Adhesive
strength: High Shear (3200 psi / 22 N/mm²) & High Peel
cure_time: Work life: 20 min; Fixture: 120 min; Full: 24 hrs
compatible_materials: Aluminum, steel, stainless steel, concrete, wood, plastics (nylon, polycarbonate)
limitations: 2:1 mix ratio via dual cartridge nozzle
usage_instructions: Dispense via dual cartridge mix nozzle. Apply to clean joint, clamp and allow 120 min fixture.

name: LOCTITE® LB 8008™ C5-A Copper Anti-Seize
chemistry: Copper and Graphite in Heavy Grease
compatible_materials: Copper, brass, cast iron, steel, stainless steel
limitations: Not for high-speed bearings
usage_instructions: Clean threads. Brush paste onto male threads and mating flange faces prior to assembly.

name: LOCTITE® SF 7070™ Cleaner & Degreaser
compatible_materials: Metals, most plastics, elastomers
applications: General purpose parts cleaning prior to adhesive/sealant application
limitations: Solvent spray; ensure proper ventilation
usage_instructions: Spray onto contaminated parts or wipe with clean cloth. Allow to dry thoroughly before applying LOCTITE products.

name: LOCTITE® SF 7649™ Primer N
cure_time: Drying time: 30-60 seconds; On-part life: 30 days
compatible_materials: Passive metals (stainless steel, aluminum, plated parts), cold temperatures, large gaps (>0.13 mm)
applications: Accelerating anaerobic cure speed on passive metals
limitations: Excessive use may reduce bond strength on very small gaps (0.05 mm)
usage_instructions: Spray onto one or both clean surfaces. Allow 1 minute to dry. Apply anaerobic product within on-part life.
